title: Distributed Scheduled Tasks & Cron Coordination
learningObjectives: Prevent duplicate execution of scheduled jobs in horizontally scaled clusters
Implement distributed leader election or distributed mutex locks (Redlock)
Handle job drift, missed schedules during outages, and catch-up policies
keyTradeoffs: Centralized cloud scheduler (e.g. AWS EventBridge) vs application-level distributed scheduler
Catch-up execution of historical intervals vs skipping to current clock time
commonPitfalls: Assuming a single server will run standard Unix cron when deployed in Kubernetes pods
Lock expiration that occurs while a long-running batch job is still executing
transferPrompt: How can recurring jobs emit events to a pub/sub bus to decouple triggers from execution logic?
